marketing.headline: Your online presence. One beautiful link.
marketing.subheadline: Everything you are and everything you create, in one customizable page.
marketing.productEyebrow: Made for creators who care about details
marketing.buildTitle: Build once. Make it unmistakably yours.
marketing.buildDescription: Arrange links, writing, images, and social profiles in a focused editor with instant preview.
marketing.customizeTitle: A canvas, not a template trap
marketing.customizeDescription: Shape typography, spacing, backgrounds, and buttons while your content remains structured and portable.
marketing.analyticsDescription: See real views and clicks without turning your audience into a collection of personal data.
marketing.publishDescription: Your live page changes only when you publish, with versioned snapshots built for speed.
marketing.finalTitle: One link that feels like you.
marketing.finalDescription: Start free. Keep your page useful. Upgrade when advanced creative tools fit your work.
marketing.freeSummary: Everything needed to publish a thoughtful page.
marketing.premiumSummary: For creators who need deeper expression and insight.
marketing.freeFeatures: 1 profile|15 blocks|100 MB storage|30-day analytics|Core themes
marketing.premiumFeatures: Expanded profiles and blocks|10 GB storage|Advanced analytics|Custom domains|Premium customization
marketing.pricingDescription: Free is useful by design. Premium unlocks advanced tools without holding your content hostage.
marketing.featurePageTitle: A serious toolkit for your public presence
marketing.featurePageDescription: OlnkTR separates your content, presentation, and published page so you can experiment without destabilizing what is live.
marketing.contentFeatureDescription: Compose structured link, text, image, heading, divider, and social blocks.
marketing.designFeatureDescription: Change presentation without rewriting the content underneath it.
marketing.securityFeatureDescription: Passwordless authentication, private media, controlled publishing, and server-side permissions.
marketing.globalFeatureDescription: English and Turkish today, with an interface designed for more languages tomorrow.
